name: fresherflow
description: Add fresher jobs, internships and walk-in drives to FresherFlow from your AI assistant, using the FresherFlow MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
FresherFlow lists fresher jobs, internships and walk-in drives in India.

With this plugin your assistant can turn a job posting you found into a correctly populated FresherFlow listing: the full field set the admin form accepts, with eligibility, salary, walk-in drive details and government vacancy details, and a read-back step so it reports what was actually stored rather than what it intended to send.

A signed-in user's community submission goes live immediately; a submission that is not a full listing is staged for a human moderator only when the caller is not signed in.
defaultPrompt: Add this job posting to FresherFlow.
Correct the salary and eligibility on the listing you just created.
Flag this job link for FresherFlow review.
